order: All statistics and score pairs in a record are [team, opponent]. The raw provider order is [designated home, designated away]. rank 1 is newest.
missing: JSON null if either value of a pair is unreported or there is no supported 90-minute statistic. Published zeros remain 0. Source null denotes absence. Statistics marked H1 and H2 include first- or second-half stoppage time. No projections replace missing measurements.

field_source_conventions.FM.identity: sources.match_api: general.homeTeam, general.awayTeam. Team selection uses sources.team_schedule or prior-season ESPN all-competition schedule plus FotMob daily.
field_source_conventions.CLUB.homeground: sources.away_club_venue: away club confirms playing/travelling to the other club’s home stadium; checked against FotMob match stadium.
field_source_conventions.FM.<period>.<key>: sources.match_api: content.stats.Periods[period].stats[].stats[key==key,type!=title].rawStats[].value. All for no extra time; if extra time key FirstHalf+SecondHalf denotes sum of the two direct period values.
field_source_conventions.PS.ld.<label>: sources.playerstats_match_page: JSON-LD homeTeam and awayTeam additionalProperty[name==label].value. Full match used only without extra time.
field_source_conventions.PS.timeline.<45|2H|90>: sources.playerstats_match_page: #corners-panel rows with ordered corner numbers and 1st-half/2nd-half/extra-time headings. Left-aligned rows home and right-aligned rows away, validated against JSON-LD home/away totals. 45 sums first-half only, 2H sums second-half only, 90 sums both. Full event sequence stored in cup_corners_evidence.json with all extra-time events separately labelled.

venue_side: neutral if ESPN explicitly records true, otherwise designated home/away. neutral_venue independently distinguishes unreported (null) from verified false.
external_dependency: lxml for alternative HTML source parsing; remainder is Python standard library.
